function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

I’m here to help with a variety of tasks—especially anything related to your smart home or just general information. Here’s a quick rundown of what I can do:

| What I can do | How it works |
|---------------|--------------|
| **Control your air conditioner** | I can set the temperature, mode (cool, heat, dry, fan, auto), fan speed, and fan position. Just tell me the values you want. |
| **Check the current AC status** | I can fetch the current mode, temperature setting, power status, and even diagnostic info if you need it. |
| **Answer questions** | From tech support to general knowledge, I can provide explanations, troubleshooting steps, or quick facts. |
| **Assist with other smart‑home devices** | While my built‑in tools focus on the AC, I can also help you think through how to control other devices or integrate them. |
| **Provide guidance on energy‑saving settings** | I can suggest optimal temperature ranges or modes based on your preferences and the time of day. |

If you’d like to try controlling the AC right now, just let me know the desired temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position. Or if you want to see what’s currently set, I can fetch the state for you. Let me know how I can assist!
